title: Passive Voice (Past)
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado la Voz Pasiva en Pasado, una estructura clave para narrar historias y reportes de la empresa.

parts.visual:
Usamos la Voz Pasiva en Pasado cuando la acción (qué pasó) es más importante que quién la hizo. 
Estructura: Objeto + verbo To Be en pasado (WAS / WERE) + verbo en Participio.
parts.audio: We use the Passive Voice in the past when the action is more important than who did it. Structure: The object, plus WAS or WERE, plus the main verb in past participle.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: Activa: Shakespeare wrote Hamlet. 
Pasiva: Hamlet WAS WRITTEN by Shakespeare. (Fue escrito). 
Negocios: The company WAS FOUNDED in 1990 (La compañía fue fundada). The emails WERE SENT yesterday (Los correos fueron enviados).
parts.audio: Examples. Active: Shakespeare wrote Hamlet. Passive: Hamlet WAS WRITTEN by Shakespeare. In business: The company WAS FOUNDED in 1990. The emails WERE SENT yesterday.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de la voz pasiva en pasado (was/were + participio).

questions.question: The company ____ founded in 1990. (Fue fundada).
The emails ____ sent yesterday morning. (Fueron enviados).
The contract was ____ by the CEO. (Firmado - participio).
The meeting ____ cancelled because of the snow. (Fue cancelada).
Two new employees ____ hired last week. (Fueron contratados).
The report was ____ in two hours. (Escrito - participio irregular).
My computer ____ stolen from my car! (Fue robada).
The office was ____ yesterday. (Limpiada - participio).
All the tickets ____ sold out in five minutes. (Fueron vendidos).
The bridge was ____ in 2005. (Construido - participio de build).
I ____ asked to lead the project. (Me pidieron / Fui pedido).
questions.explanation: I = was (I was asked = me pidieron).

questions.question: The boxes ____ delivered on time. (No fueron entregadas - Negativo).
The money ____ refunded to the client. (No fue devuelto).
We ____ invited to the conference. (Fueron/Fuimos invitados).
When ____ the telephone invented? (¿Fue inventado? - Pregunta singular).
Where ____ these products made? (¿Fueron fabricados? - Pregunta plural).
The problem was ____ very quickly. (Resuelto - participio).
The files were ____ by mistake. (Borrados - participio).
A terrible mistake ____ made. (Fue cometido).
The employees were ____ a bonus. (Se les dio - participio de give).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'was' o 'were', seguido del verbo en participio.

questions.question: The company ____ founded in 1990. (Fue - singular)
The emails ____ sent. (Fueron - plural)
The contract was ____. (Firmado - participio de sign)
The report was ____. (Escrito - participio de write)
Two employees ____ hired. (Fueron - plural)
The bridge was ____. (Construido - participio de build)
I ____ asked to do it. (Fui - I)
They ____ given a bonus. (Fueron - they)
The files were ____. (Borrados - participio de delete)
The boxes ____ delivered. (No fueron - plural contraído)
